findings.documented: Money: Indian rupees, integer, everywhere in the API (price_min, price_max in INR)
findings.actual: price_min and price_max are given in Crores (decimal float) rather than integer Indian Rupees
findings.how_found: Observed maximum price value of 12.44 instead of integer rupees
findings.impact: Requires client-side conversion by factor of 10^7 (Cr to INR) to avoid displaying incorrect prices

findings.documented: Area: Square feet, integer, everywhere in the API
findings.actual: Certain listings (primarily MagicBricks MAG- prefix) report carpet_area in square metres instead of square feet
findings.how_found: Audited listings where 2-4 BHK apartments reported carpet areas under 200
findings.impact: Calculations of price per square foot are inflated by ~10.76x without unit conversion

findings.documented: Returns valid geographic latitude and longitude coordinates
findings.actual: Several listing records have latitude and longitude values transposed (latitude > 70 and longitude ~ 19)
findings.how_found: Plotted coordinates against Mumbai bounding box; observed coordinates inverted
findings.impact: Map markers render in Antarctica / Indian Ocean unless coordinates are swapped back

findings.documented: Returns active sale listings in your city. Inactive, expired and withdrawn listings are excluded server side
findings.actual: The endpoint returns inactive listings where is_live is false
findings.how_found: Counted active listings where is_live == True vs total retrieved records
findings.impact: Frontend must explicitly filter is_live on client side to avoid displaying inactive properties

findings.documented: total_listings is recomputed whenever a listing is added or withdrawn, so it always agrees with GET /v1/listings?project_id=...
findings.actual: Reported total_listings contradicts the count of retrievable listings for the project_id across most projects
findings.how_found: Aggregated listings by project_id and compared against project total_listings field
findings.impact: Frontend displays incorrect listing counts on project pages if trusting the project metadata
